attchmntText: Vinny Overseas Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vinny Overseas Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 07, 2026. The Board reviewed and approved the Un-Audited Financial Results for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditor. The Board also approved the Internal Audit Report for the same quarter. The meeting commenced at 12:00 Noon and concluded at 01:00 PM. The financial results are available on the company website at https://www.vinnyoverseas.in/investors.html. The announcement was signed by Hiralal Jagdishchand Parekh, Managing Director, with DIN 00257758.
